title: Akkadian Empire, often called the first empire
place: Mesopotamia, Iraq (capital Akkad, site not yet found)
summary: Sargon of Akkad conquered the Sumerian city-states and united Akkadian and Sumerian speakers under one central government.
why: Often seen as the first empire in world history.

notes.problem: Place implies a known site; source: 'the location of its capital, the city of Akkad/Agade, is still unknown'.

superlativeSource: often seen as the first empire in world history
